title: Kacey Musgraves’ Lee Collection Is a Cowgirl’s Dream: Shop Our Favorite Pieces
summary: The Musgraves x Lee collection features women's and men's clothing and accessories
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Kacey Musgraves is ringing in summer the southern way with help from denim and workwear brand Lee and Walmart.

Ahead of her 2026 Middle of Nowhere tour, Musgraves is giving fans options for concert attire a la this new collaboration that we can only describe as “cowboy coquette.” The line features items for both men and women, including swimwear, adorable sleep sets, classic ringer tees and, of course, lots of denim.

The “Dry Spell” singer’s collection also includes a handful of unisex accessories such as cowboy hats, bag charms, trucker hats and so much more. For fans with pets, the line even has doggy-sized Musgraves-inspired hankies, dresses and cowboy hats. There is truly something in this new launch for everyone, especially since sizing usually ranges from XS to 3XL, depending on which item you’re eyeing.

All pieces are available now at Walmart.com . Below, we’ve included a few favorites from the singer’s 2026 Lee capsule that we’d suggest buying ahead of her tour.

Kacey Lee Women's Haven't Been Boxy Camo Tee

$18

Buy Now at walmart

Camo print is a classic Americana print pretty popular with folks down South . Transitioning from military garb, the print has been utilized in lots of streetwear silhouettes.

Camo is an Americana print that has been co-opted for mainstream usage by the fashion industry. This tee makes reference to Musgrave’s 2018 track “Slow Burn,” a sort of throwback for die-hard fans. This camo number comes in olive and tan tones, contrasted with a large yellow graphic affixed to the front. We’d purchase this tee because it’s slightly more elevated than your generic white tee. The piece is yet another style that takes a basic silhouette and turns up the dial, making it unique.

Kacey Lee Women's Woven Sleep Set

$20

This sleep set comes in an alternative pink hue called Vieled Rose. The bow and lace detailing is consistent in both colorways.

While this is marketed as a sleep set, we’d venture that you could style this two-piece outside of the bedroom, too, making for a versatile addition. For that reason alone, we’d purchase this $20 duo . It harkens to the coquette trend still replicated by the likes of Olivia Rodrigo. The lace paneling mixed with the bow accents is super sweet, while the ruched bottoms hug the frame for a little scandal, offsetting the sugary sweetness of the breezy top. To style, we’d opt for brown moto boots or crisp white sneakers with knee-high socks.

Kacey Lee Women's Tie Front Bra Bikini Top

$22

Gingham is a classic pattern that is just as American as fireworks or hot dogs. This bikini top comes with matching ruched bottoms.

Summer means it’s swim season. This Kacey Lee Women’s Tie Front Bra Bikini Top is sold separately from its matching bottoms and serves as a staple item for when you’re in the mood to take a dip. Bikini tops like this are sold solo so that they can be worn numerous ways.

For example, you can style this gingham number with existing black or red bottoms you probably already own instead of buying a full set. You could wear this swimwear as a top styled with jorts or a high-waisted skirt to festivals or to your next pool party.

Kacey Lee Men's and Big Men's Distressed Graphic Ringer Tee

$13

Ringer tees like this one are classic Americana. The style was invented back in the early 1950s and was seen as a blue-collar “working man’s” garment.

We love ringer tees because they are so effortless to style, and they instantly make your outfit look more elevated. The quintessential ringer shirt features contrasting ruched trim along the sleeves and neckline. Classic ringer tees are comfortably boxy, like this Musgraves style. The front of this collaborative piece makes reference to “Golden, Texas,” a little-known rural town with around only 160 residents that has become somewhat of a muse for Musgraves. If you’re looking for something adjacent to a plain white tee that is slightly more stylish, this should be your top pick.

Kacey Lee Men's Loose Fit Striped Bib Denim Overalls

$55

This is a railroad-striped style of overalls. Railroad stripes are essentially pinstripes, and they are sometimes referred to as hickory or engineer stripes.

Nothing says country like overalls. The historic silhouette was actually patented and produced first by Lee in 1911. This is a bib style , a silhouette worn primarily by laborers that buttons up via connecting straps that sling over the shoulders. These overalls have railroad-striping throughout in white and blue and ample pockets. We’d purchase this specific bib style because it is the most comfortable and can be adjusted to combat the hot weather. Overalls are an easy throw-on piece that makes you look as if you tried harder than you actually did.

Kacey Lee Women's Horse Pin Set, 6-Piece

$12

This is a set of six enamel pins for $12, which translates to just $2 per pin.

Enamel pins are the best way to zhuzh up a basic item in your closet. We’d take this set and stick them on the lapel of a jacket or a plain old baseball cap. You’ve got shapes like a galloping horse, a gold star and a first prize ribbon, among others.
